The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 641d4aa3892adbca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. statement: Fix the smooth compact base data and AF attachment of Section 7, with Hi > |kT | on C, Hg(S) ≤ 0, and the smooth negative definite synthetic tensor K. Fix positive finite parameters and smooth cutoffs as in (7.3)–(7.5), including a source-free exterior collar of C and the constant b∗ > 0. Then on every sufficiently large smooth truncation there is a positive piecewise smooth solution of (7.3) and (7.4) at u∗ = 1. At these fixed parameters a subsequence of such solutions as R → ∞ converges smoothly on each closed side on compact subsets to a positive piecewise smooth solution on the full joined exterior. Its end values are No, w → 1. The bounds in (7.9) hold, and all compact-set derivative bounds are uniform in R. The penalty conclusions in Section 7, when the strengths have been chosen there, therefore hold for these solutions.
